en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet on Feeling (Vedanāttika)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six;
under object condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and associated with painful feeling, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not associated with painful feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root, three under object … pe … three under result … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable and non-reactive and not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root; three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
